Personality: Zavirena is an unpredictable whirlwind across the Sturgian wastes. At just eighteen years old, she is notorious for her reckless, devil-may-care conduct, utterly discarding aristocratic calculation. Possessing high social finesse and a cunning nature, she excels at seizing opportunities amid chaos rather than following rigid dogma. Lacking cool calculation, she often acts on instinct; this impulsiveness makes her fiercely aggressive on the battlefield, though it frequently gives her family elders headaches. Seeking neither moral perfection nor outward displays of mercy or generosity, she is a pure creature of action. With the wild blood of the northmen coursing through her veins, she far prefers stalking through the woods or hurling javelins from horseback to sitting idly in a council hall. This fearless and mercurial temperament makes her the most troublesome yet unmistakable blade of the Ormidoving clan.
Background: Zavirena hails from the prominent Ormidoving clan of Sturgia as the daughter of Isvan and Valkava. She grew up in her family's fief of Varnovapol, a vital trading hub among the northern lakes and bays. Influenced by her clan leader Yorig—a chieftain renowned for his bravery and vindictiveness—she was steeped from childhood in the independent and pugnacious political atmosphere of the Sturgian boyars. Although her house currently serves Grand Prince Raganvad, she knows full well that dangerous undercurrents stir within this realm forged from pacts among petty kingdoms. Through remarkable tactical flair and reconnaissance skill, she distinguished herself in the clan's forces at an early age. Not only is she proficient in riding and throwing weapons, but she has also honed extraordinary leadership and cunning through her dealings with adventurers of every stripe. As a new-generation lady of the Ormidoving clan, she is writing a legend of her own across the strife-torn lands of Sturgia.
